system_prompt_style.note: Multi-agent EEA uses a fixed SYSTEM_PROMPT string; single-agent builds an f-string template with schema.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the embedding layer encodes these narratives into high-dimensional vectors using transformer-based models
env_context_strategy.note: Metadata Retrieval Agent grounds via embedding similarity search.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: agents exchange typed JSON outputs that act as explicit contracts between stages
context_compaction.note: No history-compaction mechanism described; each stage passes structured output.

observation_format.evidence_quote: It formats the result into a compact, human-readable table for quick inspection and hands the rows back to an LLM-assisted evaluator

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The Metadata Retrieval Agent and Query Logic Agent rely mainly on tool-calling and schema-bounded intermediate reasoning.
tool_call_format.note: JSON object outputs via OpenAI response_format; tool-calling for retrieval agents.

tool_count.note: Named tools include QueryExecution, AddColumn, QueryInfo, DoubleCheck but no complete tool registry is given.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: a built-in security mechanism blocks any query that attempts to add new rows (INSERT), modify existing data (UPDATE), manage database objects (CREATE, ALTER, DROP), or delete rows (DELETE)
edit_primitive.note: No file editing tool; output is SQL only.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The Entity Extraction Agent uses temperature 0.0 and a strict JSON schema to reduce parsing errors.
tool_schema_source.note: Prompts and schemas authored by hand in the reference implementation.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: pip install openai sqlalchemy psycopg2-binary pandas numpy requests dateparser
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A dependency in the listed requirements.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the Entity Extraction Agent interprets the question, the Metadata Retrieval Agent grounds it in the schema, the Query Logic Agent builds a high-level plan, the SQL Generation Agent converts that plan into executable PostGIS SQL, and the Review Agent validates and repairs the result
loop_primitives.note: Default is the five-stage fixed pipeline with planning and execution-based review/repair.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The agent therefore transforms the grounded context into a stepwise logical plan.
planning_granularity.note: Plan is a structured intermediate artifact passed to the SQL Generation Agent.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Each stage passes a structured intermediate representation to the next one, which reduces stage drift
multi_agent_topology.note: Orchestration component coordinates a fixed hand-off sequence of specialised agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: orchestration governs the flow of information between agents, ensuring that each one receives input in the proper format

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: The Orchestration asks clarifying questions, if needed, to clearly understand the user's intent.
human_in_loop.note: Clarification dialogue before the pipeline runs; closest to on_plan gating.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Short-term memory captures the state of the ongoing interaction, including the current user question and intermediate outputs from agents.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Long-term memory stores past user questions, generated queries at each step, execution results, employed functions, and user feedback.
long_term_memory.note: Also an embedding knowledge base of schema narratives (vector store) built at install time.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: returns the final SQL together with intermediate artifacts and token/time metrics
state_persistence.note: No resume path described for an interrupted pipeline run.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the Review Agent executes a sandboxed dry run using a QueryExecution tool which makes a read-only connection to the primary database with safety wrappers and appending a LIMIT 10 clause
self_verification.note: LLM-assisted evaluator confirms sample answers the question; DoubleCheck cross-validates.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: it approves a query if it is correct, and if the SQL statement appears incorrect, it redirects the system to revise and regenerate the query

rollback.evidence_quote: a built-in security mechanism blocks any query that attempts to add new rows (INSERT), modify existing data (UPDATE), manage database objects (CREATE, ALTER, DROP), or delete rows (DELETE)
rollback.note: Read-only execution means nothing to roll back; no undo/snapshot mechanism.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: If any check fails or detects a semantic drift, the Review Agent returns a corrected SQL statement to the end-user.
termination_condition.note: Pipeline ends when the Review Agent approves/returns SQL; can also stop early on blocking ambiguity.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Simple accumulator for OpenAI token usage and total time.
cost_controls.note: Tokens and cost are measured but no budget cap, routing or caching.

timeouts.note: Only the Nominatim validation call has an explicit timeout.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: the query execution module, which functions as a controlled sandbox environment for running automatically generated SQL statements
execution_isolation.note: Actions are SQL executed against a remote PostgreSQL/PostGIS server over a SQLAlchemy connection.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: A SQLAlchemy-compatible, preferably read-only, database connection
filesystem_access.note: Boundary is the database, not a filesystem.

network_policy.note: Outbound calls to OpenAI and Nominatim with no egress restriction configured.

permission_model.evidence_quote: a built-in security mechanism blocks any query that attempts to add new rows (INSERT), modify existing data (UPDATE), manage database objects (CREATE, ALTER, DROP), or delete rows (DELETE)

tracing.note: run_pipeline also returns intermediate artifacts and token/time metrics.

replayability.evidence_quote: returns the final SQL together with intermediate artifacts and token/time metrics

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: we adopted a manual, rationale-based evaluation protocol
eval_hooks.note: Repo ships only evaluation spreadsheets in data/, no evaluation runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Validates user questions for relevance and security before processing
guardrails.note: Security Control plus the SQL statement blocklist gate actions before execution.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Translate natural-language questions into grounded, executable, and reviewed PostgreSQL / PostGIS queries.
target_domain.note: Domain is spatial Text-to-SQL / geospatial database querying.

open_source.evidence_quote: The source code as well as a web-based user interface will be made available in a forthcoming update.
open_source.evidence_locator: paper Data and Code Availability Statement
open_source.note: Only reference scripts and data published; no LICENSE file in the tree.
